CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION track_floor_plan_pin_changes() RETURNS TRIGGER, LANGUAGE plpgsql, no SECURITY DEFINER (default SECURITY INVOKER), no search_path set in this version. Behavior: appends to NEW.edit_history a jsonb object with 'timestamp' NOW(), 'user_id' NEW.last_modified_by, and a 'changes' object containing from/to pairs for status, priority, and assigned_contractor when OLD value IS DISTINCT FROM NEW value (NULL otherwise); sets NEW.last_modified_at = NOW(); returns NEW. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.contractor_has_site_access(_user_id uuid, _site_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public. Body: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_sites WHERE user_id = _user_id AND site_id = _site_id). Reads user_sites only. Note: defined as a helper but not referenced by any policy created in this migration (policies inline the user_sites subquery instead).
